content: Hello, I am Alder Credit's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your postcode?
And what is your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 600.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your car loan has 450.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amounts for all of these today?
No, I paid the credit card's overdue amount yesterday, and the personal loan isn't mine. As for the car loan, I won't be paying that.
Let us go through them one at a time. Could you pay 900.00 for the credit card on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I already paid the credit card's overdue amount yesterday, so there's nothing more to pay on that.
Thank you. Please note that a payment may take up to two business days to show. Could you pay 600.00 for the personal loan on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, that personal loan isn't mine, so I won't be making any payment on it.
I have noted that. Could you pay 450.00 for the car loan on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I will not pay the car loan on Thursday.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
